question: do reported earnings and cash reflect economic reality?

earnings_versus_cash.finding: Over the trailing four quarters operating cash flow covers net income at {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}, above the prior fiscal year's {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} and the year before's {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}, and close to the fiscal 2023 reading of {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}. Accruals over average assets are {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets}, down from the fiscal-year reading of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets}, which was the highest of the four comparable years; that annual reading paired total net income, including the discontinued R&LC HVAC gain, with continuing-operations cash flow, so it overstated accruals, and the trailing window still carries that gain, which understates rather than flatters the trailing ratio. Working capital: the year-on-year receivables build of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change} absorbs {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.share_of_net_income|pct} of net income; inventory absorbs {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.share_of_net_income|pct}; the accounts-payable build of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change} supplies {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.share_of_net_income|pct}. In the quarter itself operating cash flow of {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter} against net income of {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter} grew {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year|pct} year on year while net income grew {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year|pct}; the release's cash-flow statement shows the quarter's inflow from accounts payable and accrued liabilities was more than half of operating cash flow, accrued income taxes added more, and the nine-month receivables outflow was many times the prior year's. MD&A says receivables increased and names no cause. Articulation: the balance-sheet receivables change sits {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.articulation_gap} from the cash-flow statement's change and inventory {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap}; both gaps are small and carry the sign that the ADT Mexico and ADT Spain divestitures and the held-for-sale transfer of ADT United Kingdom would produce; the payables gap cannot be formed because the prior fiscal year's payables line is not in the record. Smoothness is {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness}, above one, so net income has moved more than cash across the nine quarters read, driven by the discontinued-operations gain in the fiscal 2025 fourth quarter rather than by smoothing. The AFFF insurance recoveries inside both earnings and operating cash flow and the divestiture gain inside earnings are not carried by any calculator field, so they are named here and not adjusted.
earnings_versus_cash.verdict: cash backs earnings over the trailing year, but the latest quarter's cash came from liability builds and the receivables build has no stated cause; moderate quality concern, not adverse

revenue_recognition.finding: Days sales outstanding on the trailing year is {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_outstanding}; on the quarterly trend it is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, third highest of six quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} a year earlier, the lowest, and {trend_table.quarters-back-2.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} two quarters ago, the highest. Receivables over quarterly revenue is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.receivables_over_revenue} against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.receivables_over_revenue} a year earlier, so receivables have outrun revenue, which grew {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} year on year. On the annual table days sales outstanding of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} was second highest of five years, below the fiscal 2022 peak of {trend_table.years-back-3.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, so the level sits inside the company's own range. Contract liabilities move with revenue, not against it: {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities} a year earlier; over quarterly revenue {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue}, second highest of six, from the year-earlier low of {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue}; the annual ratio {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue} is the highest of five years. Deferred revenue rising with orders and backlog defers rather than accelerates recognition and supplies cash. One new judgment area: MD&A lists 'asserting contractual rights through change orders' among cost mitigations, which brings contract-modification and variable-consideration judgment into long-cycle revenue and unbilled receivables; the notes reader could not confirm the wording is new. The orders and backlog metrics changed definition: orders before fiscal 2026 exclude equipment-only sales that current orders include, and backlog but not orders was restated, so the release's orders growth is not like for like and the size of the category is not given. Gross margin is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}, the highest of six quarters, with services cost of sales down while services revenue rose; MD&A attributes EMEA margin to pricing. No policy-wording change, bill-and-hold, extended-terms or fourth-quarter-concentration disclosure is in the inputs, and the fiscal fourth quarter is absent from the trend table, so quarter concentration cannot be tested.
revenue_recognition.verdict: no acceleration of recognition found; receivables rising faster than revenue while contract liabilities also sit at a high, which fits long-cycle project billing; a watch item, not adverse

estimates_and_reserves.finding: The allowance for doubtful accounts thinned while receivables grew: the ratio is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct}, the lowest of six quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct} a year earlier and {trend_table.quarters-back-6.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct} six quarters back, the highest; the balance is {terms.balances_now.bad_debt_allowance} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.bad_debt_allowance} a year earlier while receivables rose by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change}. Lower provisioning on a growing book raises income; no paragraph in the inputs explains it and the amount of any release is not in the calculator, so no adjustment can be written. Warranty: the accrual is {terms.balances_now.warranty_accrual} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.warranty_accrual} a year earlier; the ratio to quarterly revenue is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio|pct}, third highest of six and above the year-earlier low of {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio|pct}, though down from the March quarter's high of {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio|pct}; not thinning against a year ago, and the tag changed between the 10-K and the 10-Q for the same date with equal values. Inventory reserve: not tagged in any period, so nothing can be said. Goodwill and intangibles: the quarter's acquisitions booked goodwill attributed to synergies and developed technology amortized over fifteen years, a long life that keeps amortization low; goodwill was allocated to the ADT United Kingdom disposal group, whose fair value less costs to sell is said to exceed carrying value with no write-down, whereas ADT Spain was written down in the first quarter; the judgment cannot be tested and no headroom, discount-rate or growth assumption is in the inputs. Tax: the effective rate moved against the company; the trailing rate is {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct} on tax expense {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense} and pre-tax income {terms.trailing_four_quarters.pretax_income}, the quarter's provision rose faster than pre-tax income, discrete items were a charge where last year's were a benefit, and no valuation-allowance release appears. Useful lives: ERP assets in EMEA were abandoned with lives shortened, an accelerated-depreciation charge the company excludes from adjusted results. Incentive-compensation accruals rose at corporate while MD&A lists a decrease in accrued compensation since September; the periods differ and accrued compensation is not in the calculator. The quarter's other impairments have no new explanatory text. Environmental and AFFF contingency disclosures moved both ways and none of those reserves is in the calculator.
estimates_and_reserves.verdict: adverse on the allowance, which fell to its lowest ratio as receivables rose with no explanation; warranty, tax and useful-life estimates are neutral or moved against income; goodwill judgments on the disposal groups cannot be tested

cost_deferral.finding: Capitalized software or development cost is not tagged in any period and research and development expense is not in the record for the current year to date, so no capitalized-to-expensed ratio exists. Soft assets are at their highest: {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct} of total assets, the highest of six quarters, and {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct} on the annual table, the highest of five years; property, plant and equipment fell to {terms.balances_now.property_plant_and_equipment} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.property_plant_and_equipment}, acquisitions added goodwill and developed technology, and held-for-sale assets sit outside the hard-asset lines. Trailing capital expenditure of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure} is below {terms.trailing_four_quarters_a_year_earlier.capital_expenditure} a year earlier and well below depreciation and amortization of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.depreciation_and_amortization}; MD&A cites 'a decrease in capital expenditures' as a driver of investing cash flow, so free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple} is flattered by under-spending against the asset base, with the R&LC HVAC divestiture the benign explanation. Non-recurring items recur: transformation costs rose quarter on quarter, nine months on nine months and in every trailing-twelve-month column; restructuring and impairment added back to adjusted EBITDA more than doubled across the three trailing-twelve-month columns; the GAAP charge and its noncash part rose; and the chief executive says the company is 'early in our journey', so the exclusions will continue. The adjusted-to-GAAP gap for the quarter, adjusted income above GAAP, cannot be computed by Python because no us-gaap concept carries a non-GAAP measure; the AFFF recoveries and the divestiture gain are removed from adjusted income, which cuts the other way. No calculator field carries transformation or restructuring cost, so no earnings adjustment is written.
cost_deferral.verdict: no cost capitalization found; recurring 'non-recurring' charges widen the adjusted-to-GAAP gap, and capital expenditure below depreciation flatters free cash flow

cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.finding: Receivables factoring: no proceeds-from-sale-of-receivables concept is tagged in any period, and the notes reader records the release's standing text that the factoring programme was discontinued in 2024; nothing found. Supplier finance: an obligation of {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.supplier_finance_obligation} was tagged a year earlier but no balance is tagged at the current date, while the notes carry a supplier-finance paragraph as amounts only; the year-on-year payables build of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change}, days payable of {ratios.efficiency.days_payables_outstanding} and the quarter's inflow from payables and accrued liabilities cannot be split between trade terms and the programme. Classification: the prior-year financing lines were revised from net to gross with totals unchanged, a correction inside financing rather than a shift between operating and investing; the AFFF settlement payments and insurance recoveries run through operating cash flow and the company strips the net recovery from its adjusted free cash flow, as it does a prepayment of royalty fees received for IP licensed to divested businesses, 'discrete tax payments' and JC Capital cash; those amounts are not in the calculator. Adjusted free-cash-flow conversion was far above the full-year target for the quarter and below it for nine months, moving opposite ways, on quarterly operating cash flow of {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter} that grew {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.quarter_over_quarter|pct} from the March quarter. JC Capital, the company's own customer-financing book, swung to a net loss and its operating cash flow turned to a use, with no explanation. Purchase obligations and guarantee exposure are not tagged in any period; the operating lease liability on record is {ratios.solvency.operating_lease_liability} at the September 2025 year-end, not restated for June; no variable-interest entity disclosure is in the items; the yen net-investment hedge designation dropped out of the note without a stated reason. Share-based compensation of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation}, a real cost, and acquisitions of {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions} are already taken out of quality-adjusted free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}. Trailing repurchases of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_repurchases} exceed free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple} plus dividends of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.dividends_paid}, funded by divestiture proceeds, and the diluted share count fell, so per-share growth outruns earnings growth. Net debt of {ratios.solvency.net_debt} matches the release. One adjustment is written: the payables build is removed from free cash flow as a timing source with no stated driver.
cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.verdict: moderate: operating cash flow lifted by liability builds and by non-operating insurance and royalty cash that the company itself strips from its adjusted measure; no factoring; supplier-finance size unknown here

controls_audit_and_filing_signals.finding: No auditor's report, critical audit matter, auditor change or material weakness is in the inputs; the disclosure-controls item concludes controls effective with no significant change in internal control. Against that, the same filing revises the prior-year financing cash flows because short-term debt transactions 'were incorrectly presented on a net basis', calling the error immaterial with totals unchanged, a correction the prior 10-Q had promised. Officer and director changes: three officer-or-director-change 8-K filings were made in May and June 2026 and an amended earnings-release 8-K was filed the day after the prior quarter's release; the notes reader marked them insufficient and the numbers reader cannot quote them, so whether a finance officer departed cannot be read here. Late filings: a notice of late filing for the fiscal 2023 annual report is on the list and is not new. Quiet restatement: the September 2025 balance-sheet rows the 10-K stated are unchanged in the 10-Q; backlog was restated for the new equipment-only category while orders were not; the composition of September 2025 held-for-sale assets was restated in a note the reader could not compare. MD&A says risk factors were updated and supplemented, and the update is not in the inputs. No related-party growth, subsidiary-list change or SEC comment letter is in the inputs, and the exhibit needed for the subsidiary check is absent.
controls_audit_and_filing_signals.verdict: an immaterial prior-period presentation error corrected while controls are still called effective; officer-change filings unreadable here; no auditor or restatement signal in the values

cross_document_reconciliation.finding: The 8-K earnings release and the 10-Q agree on the headline figures: quarterly revenue, net income of {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter}, operating cash flow of {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter} derived from the 10-Q's cumulative figure, receivables of {terms.balances_now.receivables}, deferred revenue of {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities}, acquisitions of {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions} and net debt of {ratios.solvency.net_debt}. Two labelled items differ across documents: the divestiture gain is one figure in the cash-flow statement and a smaller one in the non-GAAP reconciliation, with a quarterly gain in the cash-flow statement and none in the reconciliation; and the nine-month AFFF insurance recoveries are one figure in the contingency note and the release reconciliation and a smaller one in the MD&A SG&A driver. Neither document reconciles them; a basis difference is the benign reading and the inputs hold no check, so both are recorded as contradictions. Of the notes reader's items with an expected direction, the numbers confirm the acquisitions, the divestiture proceeds, the tax-rate rise, the SG&A decrease, the EMEA sales decline, the receivables and deferred-revenue increases, the capital-expenditure decrease, the repurchases and share-count decline, the guidance moves, the recurring transformation costs and the receivables growth beside the change-order wording; they contradict the AFFF figures; and they leave the environmental and PFAS items, the held-for-sale and goodwill allocations, the hedge de-designation, the officer filings and the risk-factor update unresolved because no calculator field reaches them. The full register is the reconciliation list.
cross_document_reconciliation.verdict: headline figures tie between the 8-K and the 10-Q; two labelled items carry different amounts across documents without a stated bridge

industry_lens.finding: The company is a building-technology, HVAC and controls hardware and services business rather than a semiconductor maker, so the lens is applied as hardware. Inventory obsolescence: no inventory reserve is tagged in any period; days of inventory are {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_of_inventory} on the trailing year and {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} on the quarter, the lowest of six quarters; inventory is {terms.balances_now.inventory} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.inventory} and its build absorbs {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.share_of_net_income|pct} of net income; the inventory note is a table only; nothing found. Purchase commitments in excess of need: no purchase-obligation concept is tagged and no prose addresses it; nothing found. Customer concentration: the calculator's concentration facts list is empty and no customer is named; nothing found, though demand is concentrated by end market, with the release tying Americas orders and backlog growth to data centres and mission-critical environments while Americas services backlog fell. Channel stuffing: receivables outran revenue and days sales outstanding rose year on year, but contract liabilities also rose to {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities} and backlog grew, which fits long-cycle project billing rather than loading a distribution channel; no channel inventory data exist; unresolved, leaning benign. Circular or vendor-financed deals: the company finances customers through JC Capital, defined as finance and notes receivable and sales-type lease activity, and that book swung to a net loss with its operating cash flow turning to a use, unexplained in any paragraph, while the allowance for doubtful accounts fell; the quarter's acquisitions of Alloy Enterprises and Nantum AI are of a supplier and a software business, not customers, so no investment in a customer that then buys from the company is found.
industry_lens.verdict: no inventory, purchase-commitment or named-customer signal; vendor financing through JC Capital carries an unexplained loss and demand is concentrated in data-centre projects

Receivables rose by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change} and days sales outstanding reached {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}; the inputs do not split contract assets from billed receivables, and the reader could not confirm the wording is new.

anomalies.name: Orders growth compares a widened definition against an unrestated base
anomalies.name_ko: 정의가 바뀐 수주 증가율과 소급되지 않은 비교 기준
anomalies.what: The release states that orders before fiscal 2026 exclude certain equipment-only sales for longer-cycle projects and that backlog, but not orders, was restated to include the category, so the stated organic orders growth sets a wider current definition against a narrower prior year; the size of the category is not given. GAAP revenue grew {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} year on year.

anomalies.name: Gross margin at a six-quarter high attributed to pricing
anomalies.name_ko: 가격 인상으로 설명되는 여섯 분기 최고 매출총이익률
anomalies.what: Gross margin is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}, the highest of six quarters, and {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct} on the annual table, the highest of five years; services cost of sales fell while services revenue rose. MD&A attributes EMEA margin to favourable pricing and productivity while describing cost pressure from the Middle East conflicts; a price-led margin holds only as long as pricing does.

anomalies.name: Allowance for doubtful accounts thins to its lowest while receivables rise
anomalies.name_ko: 매출채권은 늘고 대손충당금은 최저로 얇아짐
anomalies.what: The allowance ratio is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct}, the lowest of six quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct} a year earlier and {trend_table.quarters-back-6.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct} at the six-quarter high; the balance is {terms.balances_now.bad_debt_allowance} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.bad_debt_allowance} while receivables rose by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change}. A smaller allowance on a larger book raises income. No paragraph explains it and the amount released is not in the calculator.

anomalies.name: Warranty accrual down from March but above a year ago
anomalies.name_ko: 삼월보다 줄었으나 일 년 전보다 두터운 보증충당부채
anomalies.what: The accrual is {terms.balances_now.warranty_accrual} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.warranty_accrual} a year earlier; the ratio to quarterly revenue is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio|pct}, down from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio|pct} in the March quarter but above {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio|pct} a year earlier; the roll-forward is a table with no prose, and the tag changed between the 10-K and the 10-Q for the same date with equal values. Not thinning against a year ago.

anomalies.name: No write-down on ADT United Kingdom while ADT Spain was written down
anomalies.name_ko: ADT 스페인은 손상, ADT 영국은 손상 없음
anomalies.what: Goodwill was allocated to the ADT United Kingdom disposal group and the note says fair value less costs to sell exceeds carrying value, so nothing was written down, whereas the ADT Spain group was impaired in the first quarter and then sold with no gain or loss. The sale is expected to close in fiscal 2027; the judgment cannot be tested in the numbers and no held-for-sale or goodwill field exists.

anomalies.name: Acquired developed technology amortized over fifteen years
anomalies.name_ko: 십오 년에 걸쳐 상각하는 취득 개발기술
anomalies.what: The quarter's acquisitions booked goodwill attributed to synergies plus developed technology amortized straight-line over fifteen years, a long life for liquid-cooling and software technology that keeps amortization low; the split between goodwill and technology and the life are management estimates; acquisition cash on the trailing year was {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions}.

anomalies.name: Effective tax rate rose; no income-raising tax item
anomalies.name_ko: 실효세율 상승, 이익을 높인 세금 항목 없음
anomalies.what: The trailing effective rate is {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct} on tax expense of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense} and pre-tax income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.pretax_income}; the quarter's rate is described as above the statutory rate, the adjusted rate rose, discrete items were a charge where last year's were a benefit, and 'the tax impact of current and planned divestitures' lifts the rate. Clean: the estimate moved against income.

anomalies.name: ERP useful lives shortened; charge excluded from adjusted results
anomalies.name_ko: ERP 자산 내용연수 단축과 조정이익에서의 제외
anomalies.what: A change in ERP strategy in EMEA led to assets being abandoned and useful lives reduced; the accelerated depreciation appears in both current trailing-twelve-month columns and not a year earlier, and is excluded from adjusted EBITDA. Trailing depreciation and amortization is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.depreciation_and_amortization}. A cost of past capitalisation taken outside adjusted earnings.

anomalies.name: Incentive accruals rise while accrued compensation falls
anomalies.name_ko: 성과급 충당은 늘고 미지급 보상은 줄어듦
anomalies.what: The release attributes higher corporate expense to increased incentive-compensation accruals and timing, while MD&A lists a decrease in accrued compensation among the working-capital movements since September. The periods differ, quarter against year to date, and accrued compensation is not in the calculator, so the two cannot be tied.

anomalies.name: Other impairments in the quarter without new explanation
anomalies.name_ko: 설명 없는 분기 기타 손상차손
anomalies.what: The restructuring and impairment charge rose for the quarter and the nine months and its noncash part rose faster; the MD&A table shows an other-impairments line for the quarter, and the only new impairment prose concerns ADT Spain in the first quarter and no adjustment for ADT United Kingdom. Nothing in the inputs explains the quarter's other impairments.

anomalies.name: Environmental and PFAS contingency disclosures move both ways
anomalies.name_ko: 양방향으로 움직인 환경·PFAS 우발부채 공시
anomalies.what: Federal rules eased: the EPA withdrew one proposed hazardous-waste rule and a proposal to rescind several contaminant limits was published; Wisconsin tightened: drinking-water standards were approved and a draft rule would adopt the federal limits as state law where the remediation sites sit; the state enforcement action was resolved with a payment to a PFAS fund and continuing remediation; new proceedings were added in Quebec, naming the parent, and in Belgium; the conditional asset-retirement-obligation sentence was removed with no replacement. None of the environmental, AFFF or asset-retirement reserves is in the calculator.

anomalies.name: 'Non-recurring' transformation and restructuring costs recur and rise
anomalies.name_ko: 반복되며 커지는 '일회성' 전환·구조조정 비용
anomalies.what: Transformation costs excluded from adjusted income rose for the quarter, the nine months and across each trailing-twelve-month column; restructuring and impairment added back to adjusted EBITDA more than doubled across the three trailing-twelve-month columns; the GAAP restructuring charge rose for the quarter and nine months and the noncash portion with it. The chief executive says the company is 'early in our journey', so the exclusions continue. No calculator field carries these costs, so no earnings adjustment is written.

anomalies.name: Capital expenditure below depreciation while soft assets peak
anomalies.name_ko: 감가상각에 못 미치는 설비투자와 최고치의 소프트 자산
anomalies.what: Trailing capital expenditure {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters_a_year_earlier.capital_expenditure} a year earlier and depreciation and amortization {terms.trailing_four_quarters.depreciation_and_amortization}; property, plant and equipment {terms.balances_now.property_plant_and_equipment} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.property_plant_and_equipment}; soft-asset share {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct}, the highest of six quarters. MD&A cites the capex decrease as an investing driver. Free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple} is lifted by under-spending; the R&LC HVAC divestiture shrinking the asset base is the benign reading.

anomalies.name: Supplier finance balance absent from numbers as payables build
anomalies.name_ko: 매입채무가 늘어나는데 공급망금융 잔액은 수치에 없음
anomalies.what: A supplier finance obligation of {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.supplier_finance_obligation} was tagged a year earlier; no balance is tagged at the current date, though the notes carry a supplier-finance paragraph as amounts only. Accounts payable rose by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change} year on year with days payable at {ratios.efficiency.days_payables_outstanding}, and the quarter's inflow from payables and accrued liabilities was more than half of operating cash flow. Whether the programme grew cannot be read here.

anomalies.name: Insurance recoveries, prepaid royalties and discrete tax payments inside operating cash flow
anomalies.name_ko: 영업현금흐름 안의 보험금 회수·선수 로열티·일회성 세금
anomalies.what: The company's adjusted free cash flow removes net AFFF settlement payments and insurance recoveries, a prepayment of royalty fees received for IP licensed to divested businesses, discrete non-US tax settlements and JC Capital cash; the nine-month net AFFF item was a recovery removed from adjusted cash flow where last year's was a payment added back. GAAP operating cash flow of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow} on the trailing year includes these; the amounts are not in the calculator, so no adjustment is written.

anomalies.name: Adjusted free-cash-flow conversion diverges between quarter and nine months
anomalies.name_ko: 분기와 누적 조정 잉여현금흐름 전환율의 엇갈림
anomalies.what: Adjusted conversion is well above the full-year target for the quarter and below it for nine months, moving in opposite directions, while the target itself is unchanged; the quarter's strength rests on the payables and accrued-liabilities inflow. Quarterly operating cash flow of {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter} grew {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.quarter_over_quarter|pct} from the March quarter.

anomalies.name: Prior-year financing flows re-presented gross
anomalies.name_ko: 총액으로 다시 표시된 전년도 재무활동 현금흐름
anomalies.what: Proceeds from and repayments of debt for certain short-term transactions in the prior-year nine months were shown net and are now gross; the note says financing totals and the change in cash are unchanged and the error is not material. The calculator holds prior-year-to-date borrowing issued and repaid but no earlier presentation to compare, so the regrossing cannot be checked here. A correction within financing, not between operating and investing.

anomalies.name: Yen net-investment hedge designation dropped without a stated reason
anomalies.name_ko: 이유 없이 사라진 엔화 순투자 헤지 지정
anomalies.what: At the June quarter-end only euro-denominated debt is named as a partial net-investment hedge, whereas the September 2025 designation also included yen-denominated obligations; the text gives no reason and the March wording is not in the inputs. Where the yen exposure now sits in earnings or comprehensive income cannot be read.

anomalies.name: Repurchases exceed free cash flow and lift per-share growth
anomalies.name_ko: 잉여현금흐름을 넘는 자사주 매입과 주당 지표
anomalies.what: Trailing repurchases of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_repurchases} against free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple} and dividends of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.dividends_paid}, funded by the R&LC HVAC proceeds and borrowing; diluted shares fell, so adjusted EPS growth and its raised guidance outrun quarterly earnings growth of {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year|pct}. Share-based compensation of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation} is a real cost and is already deducted in quality-adjusted free cash flow.

anomalies.name: Presentation error corrected while controls are called effective
anomalies.name_ko: 표시 오류를 수정하면서도 통제는 유효하다고 결론
anomalies.what: The filing revises prior-year financing cash flows that 'were incorrectly presented on a net basis' and in the same document concludes disclosure controls effective with no significant change in internal control. The error is called immaterial and totals unchanged. The two statements are not reconciled in the inputs.

anomalies.name: Officer-change filings, an amended release and the risk-factor update cannot be read
anomalies.name_ko: 읽을 수 없는 임원 변동 공시·정정 실적발표·위험요인 갱신
anomalies.what: Three officer-or-director-change 8-K filings were made in May and June 2026 and an amended earnings-release 8-K was filed the day after the prior quarter's release; neither reader could itemise them, so whether a finance officer departed is unknown here. MD&A says risk factors were updated and supplemented and the update is not in the inputs. A notice of late filing for the fiscal 2023 annual report sits on the list and is not new.

anomalies.name: Divestiture gain differs between cash-flow statement and non-GAAP table
anomalies.name_ko: 현금흐름표와 비GAAP 조정표의 매각이익 불일치
anomalies.what: The release's cash-flow statement prints a nine-month gain on business divestiture larger than the gain the non-GAAP reconciliation removes, and a quarterly gain where the reconciliation removes none; the note ties the gain to the ADT Mexico and ADTi sales. A pre-tax against net basis is the benign reading; neither document reconciles them and the input holds no check.

anomalies.name: AFFF recovery figures differ across note, MD&A and release
anomalies.name_ko: 주석·MD&A·실적발표의 AFFF 회수액 불일치
anomalies.what: The contingency note and the release reconciliation carry one nine-month figure for AFFF insurance recoveries recorded in SG&A; MD&A names a smaller nine-month figure and a quarterly figure one below the release's as the SG&A driver. All three label the same item. The inputs give no basis for the difference.

anomalies.name: Release and 10-Q agree on headline figures
anomalies.name_ko: 실적발표와 10-Q의 핵심 수치 일치
anomalies.what: Net income {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter}, operating cash flow {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter} (the 10-Q's cumulative figure less the March year-to-date), receivables {terms.balances_now.receivables}, deferred revenue {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities}, acquisitions {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions} and net debt {ratios.solvency.net_debt} all match the release. Clean.

anomalies.name: Customer financing book (JC Capital) turns to a loss
anomalies.name_ko: 손실로 돌아선 고객금융 부문 JC Capital
anomalies.what: JC Capital, defined as finance and notes receivable and sales-type lease activity, swung to a net loss for the quarter and nine months from income a year earlier, and its operating cash flow turned to a use; no paragraph explains the loss or any credit loss on those receivables. This is the company financing its customers' purchases, and the allowance for doubtful accounts fell to {terms.balances_now.bad_debt_allowance} at the same time.

anomalies.name: Orders and backlog growth concentrated in data-centre demand
anomalies.name_ko: 데이터센터 수요에 집중된 수주 성장
anomalies.what: The release ties Americas orders and backlog growth to data centres and mission-critical environments, and MD&A to large-scale data-center projects, while Americas services backlog fell. No customer concentration fact is tagged; the calculator's concentration facts list is empty. End-market concentration, not a named customer.

anomalies.name: Inventory turning faster; no obsolescence signal
anomalies.name_ko: 빨라진 재고 회전, 진부화 징후 없음
anomalies.what: Days of inventory are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} for the quarter, the lowest of six quarters, and {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_of_inventory} on the trailing year; inventory is {terms.balances_now.inventory} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.inventory}; no inventory reserve is tagged and the inventory note is a table only. Clean.

adjustments.name: Remove the accounts-payable build from free cash flow as an unexplained timing source
adjustments.quote: The change in accounts payable and accrued liabilities provided 701 for three months against 258, and 764 for nine months against 31.

summary_ko.earnings_versus_cash: 최근 네 분기 영업현금흐름은 순이익의 {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}배로 직전 회계연도의 {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}배보다 높고, 평균자산 대비 발생액도 {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets}로 낮아 이익이 현금으로 뒷받침됩니다. 다만 매출채권 증가분 {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change}달러가 순이익의 {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.share_of_net_income|pct}를 흡수했고 이번 분기 현금은 매입채무와 미지급금 증가에 크게 기댔는데, 회사는 매출채권이 늘어난 이유를 설명하지 않습니다.
summary_ko.revenue_recognition: 매출채권 회수기간은 최근 네 분기 기준 {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_outstanding}일, 분기 기준 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}일로 일 년 전 {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}일보다 길어져 매출채권이 매출보다 빨리 늘었습니다. 그러나 계약부채도 {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities}달러로 늘어 분기 매출 대비 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue}배에 이르므로 수익을 앞당겨 인식한 징후는 없고, 수주 지표의 정의 변경과 변경주문 관련 판단이 새로 지켜볼 점입니다.
summary_ko.estimates_and_reserves: 대손충당금 비율이 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct}로 여섯 분기 중 가장 낮아졌는데 일 년 전에는 {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct}였고, 같은 기간 매출채권은 {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change}달러 늘었으며 회사는 이유를 밝히지 않습니다. 보증충당부채는 일 년 전보다 두텁고, 실효세율은 {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct}로 올라 세금 쪽에서 이익을 끌어올린 항목은 없습니다.
summary_ko.cost_deferral: 자본화된 개발비는 태그되지 않아 검증할 수 없고, 소프트 자산 비중은 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct}로 여섯 분기 중 최고입니다. 최근 네 분기 설비투자 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure}달러는 감가상각비 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.depreciation_and_amortization}달러에 크게 못 미쳐 잉여현금흐름이 부풀려 보이고, 일회성이라는 전환비용과 구조조정비용은 매 기간 커지며 반복됩니다.
summary_ko.cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh: 매출채권 팩토링은 없고, 공급망금융 잔액은 일 년 전 {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.supplier_finance_obligation}달러였으나 이번 분기 수치는 계산기에 없어 매입채무 증가분 {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change}달러를 거래조건과 프로그램으로 나눌 수 없습니다. AFFF 보험금 회수와 선수 로열티가 영업현금흐름 안에 들어 있어 회사 스스로 조정 잉여현금흐름에서 빼며, 자사주 매입 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_repurchases}달러는 잉여현금흐름 {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}달러를 넘어 주당 지표를 끌어올립니다.
summary_ko.controls_audit_and_filing_signals: 내부통제는 유효하다고 결론지었지만 같은 보고서에서 전년도 재무활동 현금흐름이 순액으로 잘못 표시되었다며 수정했고, 2026년 오월과 유월의 임원 변동 8-K 세 건과 정정 실적발표 8-K는 입력에 내용이 없어 읽을 수 없습니다. 감사인 교체나 중요한 취약점은 발견되지 않았고, 2025년 구월 말 재무상태표 수치는 10-K와 10-Q가 일치합니다.
summary_ko.cross_document_reconciliation: 8-K 실적발표와 10-Q는 분기 순이익 {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter}달러, 영업현금흐름 {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter}달러, 순부채 {ratios.solvency.net_debt}달러 등 핵심 수치가 일치합니다. 다만 사업 매각이익은 현금흐름표와 비GAAP 조정표에서 금액이 다르고, AFFF 보험금 회수액도 주석과 MD&A와 실적발표에서 서로 달라 두 항목은 문서 간 모순으로 기록합니다.
summary_ko.industry_lens: 재고 회전일수는 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}일로 여섯 분기 중 가장 짧아 재고 진부화 징후가 없고, 고객 집중도 사실은 계산기에 하나도 없습니다. 다만 회사가 JC Capital을 통해 고객에게 직접 금융을 제공하는데 이 부문이 설명 없이 손실로 돌아섰고, 수주 성장은 데이터센터 수요에 집중되어 있습니다.

limits: This analysis finds where the numbers and the explanations disagree, and where the company differs from its own past. It does not judge intent, and it cannot see evidence outside the filings, such as invoices or contracts.
